mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lining to the blood route was most worthwhile: the villus cutaway explained how folds provide surface and keep the crossing short.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying glucose with the blood route was confusing because the new goal named glucose, but the absorbing surface had to be completed first.

surprise.text: The final compatibility hint combined the two nutrients with each other to show their shared trip to the liver.

arbitrary.text: That final pairing felt a little arbitrary: the vein seemed like the natural partner, even though the result made the shared route clear.

continue.text: I might continue: seeing the lining, capillaries and nutrients come together helped me picture absorption, though the hidden prerequisites made some choices confusing.
